tournament.name: Pro Tour The Lord of The Rings

decks.notes: This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive gameplay by utilizing powerful creatures and disruption. The deck aims to quickly apply pressure on the opponent by playing efficient creatures such as Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Orcish Bowmasters. It also includes disruption and hand control with cards like Thoughtseize and Dauthi Voidwalker to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Additionally, the deck has some removal spells like Terminate and Fatal Push to deal with opposing threats. The inclusion of Feign Death and Undying Malice allows for additional value and tricks. The deck also utilizes a small black splash for extra versatility.

The key concept of this deck is to control the game by utilizing the UrzaTron lands to generate large amounts of mana and play powerful threats. The deck aims to assemble Urza's Mine, Urza's Power Plant, and Urza's Tower to maximize mana production. It includes various artifacts and spells to search for these lands, manipulate the board state, and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also includes cards like Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger and Wurmcoil Engine as win conditions. Overall, the deck focuses on resource management, disruption, and powerful late-game threats.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the Amulet of Vigor to generate powerful combos and ramp up mana. The deck focuses on playing lands and utilizing cards like Dryad of the Ilysian Grove and Azusa, Lost but Seeking to quickly generate mana and trigger land abilities multiple times. Primeval Titan is a key card in the deck, allowing the player to search for powerful lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and Vesuva to generate additional triggers and deal damage to the opponent. The deck also includes cards like Urza's Saga and Golgari Rot Farm to provide utility and flexibility in gameplay.

This deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Urza's Power Plant, Urza's Tower) to generate a massive amount of mana to cast powerful and game-changing threats such as Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger and Karn Liberated. The deck also utilizes control elements like Oblivion Stone, Relic of Progenitus, and Dismember to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Additionally, the deck includes versatile cards like Ancient Stirrings and Sylvan Scrying to help find key pieces of the Tron lands. The goal is to control the game and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats.

The key concept of this deck is to aggressively utilize cascade abilities to gain card advantage and overwhelm the opponent. The deck focuses on casting Crashing Footfalls and Lórien Revealed with Violent Outburst to create a large number of 4/4 Rhino tokens. Shardless Agent and Dead / Gone provide additional cascade effects, allowing for multiple spells to be cast in a single turn. The deck also includes disruption with Force of Negation and Mystical Dispute to protect its game plan. The inclusion of Murktide Regent and Questing Beast adds additional threats and firepower to the deck.

This deck utilizes cascade mechanics to quickly and efficiently cast powerful spells for minimal mana cost, overwhelming the opponent with aggression. By cascading into high-impact cards such as Crashing Footfalls, the deck aims to flood the board with threats and close out games quickly. The deck also includes control elements like Force of Negation and Subtlety to disrupt opponent's game plan and protect its own strategy. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's multi-colored spells and ensure consistency in casting its powerful spells.

This deck focuses on quickly casting powerful spells with cascade and overwhelming the opponent with a swarm of creatures. Key cards like Violent Outburst and Shardless Agent allow you to cascade into more impactful spells like Crashing Footfalls, giving you a constant stream of threats. The deck also includes disruption with cards like Subtlety and Force of Negation to control the board while you build your army. With a mix of aggression and control, this deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver your opponent for a swift victory.

The key concept of this deck is utilizing the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Urza's Power Plant, and Urza's Tower) in order to generate a large amount of mana and cast powerful threats such as Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger and Wurmcoil Engine. The deck also utilizes control elements like Oblivion Stone and Dismember to remove opposing threats, as well as card draw and selection with Expedition Map, Ancient Stirrings, and Chromatic Sphere. Karn, the Great Creator and Karn Liberated provide additional control and disruption, while The One Ring acts as a win condition and Boseiju, Who Endures provides protection for important spells.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on fast and aggressive plays, utilizing efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker to quickly deal damage to the opponent. It also includes disruptive elements like Grief and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes some control elements like Terminate and Lightning Bolt to remove threats. The inclusion of cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Feign Death allows for additional value generation and card advantage. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of speed, disruption, and power.

The core idea of this deck is to apply constant pressure and burn the opponent quickly. The deck focuses on aggressive creatures like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear, along with a variety of burn spells such as Lightning Bolt, Lava Spike, and Rift Bolt. The aim is to deal damage rapidly and efficiently, while also disrupting the opponent's plans with cards like Skullcrack and Searing Blaze. The inclusion of cards like Boros Charm and Roiling Vortex further enhances the deck's aggressive strategy. The deck also utilizes a combination of lands that provide colored mana efficiently.

This deck focuses on deploying threats quickly through the Cascade mechanic, using cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst to cheat out expensive spells like Crashing Footfalls. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruptive spells while maintaining card advantage with cards like Subtlety and Lórien Revealed. The deck also includes interaction like Mystical Dispute and Force of Negation to control the opponent's game plan. The land base is designed to support the deck's mana requirements and provide flexibility with options like Gemstone Caverns and Boseiju, Who Endures.

This deck focuses on quickly playing multiple spells to trigger cascade effects and overwhelm the opponent with a flood of creatures. The deck also includes a few versatile spell options like Fire/Ice and Dead/Gone for added flexibility. This deck focuses on combining creatures and utilizing them as a toolbox to achieve victory. It includes powerful creatures like Sheoldred, Yawgmoth, and Zulaport Cutthroat. The key concept of the deck is to quickly equip a Colossus Hammer onto a creature, preferably with the help of Stoneforge Mystic and Puresteel Paladin. The deck also includes cards like Esper Sentinel and Giver of Runes to disrupt the opponent's plans and protect its own creatures. This deck focuses on a strategy known as mill, which involves forcing the opponent to put cards from their library into their graveyard. The key concept revolves around utilizing cards like Hedron Crab and Ruin Crab to continuously mill the opponent, while also taking advantage of cards like Archive Trap and Fractured Sanity to mill a large number of cards at once. The deck also includes disruption and removal spells like Drown in the Loch and Fatal Push to control the opponent's board. Overall, the goal is to deplete the opponent's library and win by forcing them to draw from an empty deck.
